category.desc: Only return skills in this category.

cursor.desc: Paginate through collections of data by setting the `cursor` parameter to a `next_cursor` attribute returned by a previous request's `response_metadata`. Must be used with the same `filter` and `category`.

filter.desc: `library`: skills enabled for the caller, including auto-enabled skills and skills from skill sets. `owned`: skills the caller created. `catalog`: the organization's official skills.

limit.desc: The maximum number of skills to return. Fewer may be returned even when more remain.

desc: Lists Slackbot skills from the caller's point of view. Instructions are not included.

errors.feature_not_enabled: The Skills API isn't enabled for this organization.
errors.invalid_category: The category isn't one of the supported skill categories.
errors.invalid_cursor: The cursor is malformed, expired, or was issued for a different filter or category.
errors.restricted_action: The caller isn't allowed to use skills.
